findings.title: DATABASE_URL is not validated at startup.

findings.title: Logger has no redaction of the authorization header.
The admin usage route is registered before authenticate/requireRole, so it is reachable without a token.
Document delete has no ownership or share check, so any authenticated user can delete any document by id.
findings.evidence: const { rowCount } = await pool.query('DELETE FROM documents WHERE id = $1', [req.params.id]);

findings.title: "subtotalCents += await ..." reads the old total before each await, so concurrent meters overwrite each other and the subtotal is wrong.
findings.evidence: subtotalCents += await meterChargeCents(teamId, meter, start, end);

findings.title: sendMail promise is returned without await inside try, so the catch never runs and SMTP failures propagate.
The pooled client is only released on success; query errors and the 57014 timeout path leak the connection (no finally).
setUTCMonth(+1) overflows on month-end dates (for example 31 Jan becomes early March).
Money computed with floating-point arithmetic and stored as a decimal amount.
The quota-warning, search, delete and invoice routes have no tests.
